text:
Ana: Quick experiment idea — 1-week micro-sprint to test whether prompt-template nudges + starter credits lift 7-day activation for new signups. TL;DR: small sample, fast learn.

Sam: Love it. Targeting demo + self-serve signups? What's the primary metric & sample size?

Ana: Target = demo + self-serve. Primary metric = activation (>=3 meaningful API calls) within 7 days. Sample ~6k new users (splits below).

Leo: Keep copy tight. Propose 3 arms: control, credits-only, credits+templates+in-app nudge. Optional timed nudge if we have capacity.

Maria: Recommend metrics: activation_3_calls, retention_7d, median tokens/session. Also track prompt_template_id when chosen.

Ana: Plan: 50% control, 25% 50-free-tokens, 25% 50-free-tokens + prompt-bundle + in-app "Try this" card. Rollout: ramp to variant splits over 6h. Start Mon 09:00 UTC. :rocket:

Sam: OK. Confirm tracking events: signup.source, cohort, experiment_id, variant. Eng, can we add a feature flag? @Zoe?

Zoe: Put me on infra for flags. Note: ensure credit ledger only applies to orgs created during the window (edge case if users recreate orgs).

eng-bot: Feature flag created: micro_prompt_playbook_v1.rollout=25% (credits_only), 25% (credits_plus_templates) — scheduled 2026-03-23T09:00Z by @devops-bot.

Leo: Draft copy for in-app card: "Try our prompt templates to get useful outputs fast — 50 free tokens included." Short + CTA. Will add 2 more wording variations.

Ana: Sample experiment config — please review:
```
experiment_id: micro_prompt_playbook_v1
variants:
  - control: 50%
  - credits_only: 25% # 50 free tokens
  - credits_plus_templates: 25% # card + templates bundle
metrics:
  - activation_3_calls
  - retention_7d
  - tokens_per_session
windows:
  - start: 2026-03-23T09:00Z
  - end: 2026-03-30T09:00Z
```

Maria: Love it. Schedule a 30m sync 48h after start to check early signals and safety checks. Marketing, please prep 2 social posts + a short blog blurb if we see a lift.

Sam: @Ana can you own the dashboard? I'll wire up an Amplitude funnel + Segment mapping.

Ana: Yep — I will create an activation dashboard and a short hypothesis doc. Tracking sheet: https://tiny.red/ppb-tracking 

Leo: I'll drop the 3 starter templates + examples in the doc and tag everyone for copy review.

Zoe: After the experiment, quick retro + decision tree: scale credits, try smaller credit amount, test different template bundles, or scoped in-app tours.

Ana: Thanks all — small & fast. If nobody objects, I'll push the experiment ticket and the flag rollout details by EOD. :white_check_mark:
